tables.markdown:
| Review responsibility | What to read closely | Judgment to record |
|---|---|---|
| Payment domain owner | Order/key relationship, amount source, charge call and state transitions | When a request may charge, reuse a result or be rejected |
| QA / test reviewer | Fixtures, assertions, failure cases and surviving mutants | Whether important requirements have tests that distinguish incorrect behavior |
| Integration / operations reviewer | Changes involving shared storage, concurrency, restarts, provider lookup and reconciliation | What the test environment establishes and what evidence deployment still needs |

| Review concern | Treatment in this example | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Could a repeated request charge again? | Retain as C1: two requests, one charge attempt | Clear consequence and a requirement future retry changes must preserve |
| Could a key be rebound? | Retain as C2: reject the conflicting relationship before another provider call | An explicit identity boundary and observable result |
| Could a decline or timeout appear successful? | Separate C3 and C4, using different provider scenarios | A known rejection and an unknown outcome require different judgments |
| Rename a local variable | Address in this change; use lint for established conventions | Not every naming preference needs a behavior test |
| Should the campaign offer refunds? | Ask the product and payment owners to settle policy first | The expected result is undefined; an agent cannot invent the approved answer |

| ID | Deliberate code change | Observable consequence | Initial happy-path tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Send NTD 1 to the provider | Charged amount differs from the order | killed |
| M2 | Skip the existing-attempt guard | Repeating an operation may charge again | survived |
| M3 | Remove the cross-order key rejection | The same key can pay another order | survived |
| M4 | Mark a decline `PAID` | A rejected payment appears successful | survived |
| M5 | Mark a timeout `PAID` | An unknown outcome appears successful | survived |
| M6 | Put sweetened tea on the successful receipt | Receipt product differs from the order | killed |
| M7 | Remove the pre-call PENDING record | Replay after another connection error may charge again | survived |

| Test selection | Killed / scored | Mutation score | Survivors |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two happy-path tests | 2 / 7 | 28.6% | M2, M3, M4, M5, M7 |
| Eight tests, omitting the timeout case | 6 / 7 | 85.7% | M5 |
| All nine payment tests | 7 / 7 | 100.0% | None of these seven |
